thread:
julia: Heads-up: us-west1b showing rising GPU pending and rapid tiny-pod churn since we added r-ampa-09. Tiny jobs (0.125-0.5 GPU) land then get preempted within ~1m. Anyone digging in?

omar: saw it at ~02:10 PDT. Scheduler traces show fragment penalties pushing small pods to non-preferred NVLINK racks, then preemption.

infra-bot: ALERT: us-west1b.fragmented_slots_pct = 13.2% (10m), preempt_events = 77 (10m).

ben: quick idea: try a packing-floor override for pods requesting <0.5 GPU to treat them as 0.5 when scoring. Also bump tiny-pod toleration to 90s to reduce hop-on-transient noise.

julia: agree. risk is a bit more unused capacity but likely net win from fewer restarts. ops, can we run a canary?

ops_mgr: yes. Run 3h canary in us-west1b-c only. Abort if preempt_events increase >6% or fragmented_slots_pct increases >4% within 30m. Monitor attach_latency too.

omar: I'll deploy a configmap patch and synthetic stress job (200 tiny pods ramp 1s) to validate. Config snippet: `packing_floor: { default: 0.0, small_override: 0.5 }`

ben: I'll add dashboard tags: experiment=pack-floor, pack_floor=0.5, region=us-west1b-c. Revert window set to 15m automated rollback.

julia: SG. Post first-30m summary here. Tagging oncall. :mag:
